      hint: "Enter the password to unlock this clue.",
      text: "That's stumps for tonight; you've played a fine game,\nBut tomorrow's the finale - the prize and the fame.\nYour gift stays hidden till the last day is through;\none final innings is waiting for you!" }

let unlocked = 0;

const save = () => { try { localStorage.setItem(KEY, unlocked); } catch(e){} };
const norm = s => s.normalize("NFD").replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, "").toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9 ]/g, "").trim().replace(/\s+/g, " ");
const $ = id => document.getElementById(id);

const GAME = [
  {name:"Extras", color:"#f2d44f", words:["LEG BYE","BYE","WIDE","NO-BALL"]},
  {name:"Ways to get out", color:"#8fc96a", words:["CAUGHT","STUMPED","BOWLED","RUN OUT"]},
  {name:"Batting shots", color:"#7fb2e5", words:["DRIVE","SWEEP","CUT","PULL"]},

function buildGame(box, onWin){
  const shuffle = a => { for (let i=a.length-1;i>0;i--){ const j=Math.floor(Math.random()*(i+1)); [a[i],a[j]]=[a[j],a[i]]; } return a; };
  const mk = (tag, cls, txt) => { const e = document.createElement(tag); if (cls) e.className = cls; if (txt) e.textContent = txt; return e; };
  let order = shuffle(GAME.flatMap(g => g.words)), sel = [], found = [], mistakes = 0, msg = "";
  const wrap = mk("div","game");
  box.appendChild(wrap);
  function submit(){
    const hit = GAME.find(g => sel.every(w => g.words.includes(w)));
    if (hit){ found.push(hit); sel = []; msg = "Correct!"; draw(); if (found.length === 4) onWin(); return; }
    const best = Math.max(...GAME.map(g => sel.filter(w => g.words.includes(w)).length));
    mistakes++; msg = best === 3 ? "One away!" : "Not quite — try another set."; sel = []; draw();
  }
  function draw(){
    wrap.innerHTML = "";
    found.forEach(g => {
      const bar = mk("div","grp");
      bar.style.background = g.color;
      bar.appendChild(mk("b","",g.name));
      bar.appendChild(mk("span","",g.words.join(", ")));
      wrap.appendChild(bar);
    });
    const left = order.filter(w => !found.some(g => g.words.includes(w)));
    if (!left.length){ wrap.appendChild(mk("p","msg","Puzzle solved! Your clue is on its way…")); return; }
    const grid = mk("div","tiles");
    left.forEach(w => {
      const t = mk("button","tile" + (sel.includes(w) ? " sel" : ""), w);
      t.type = "button";
      t.onclick = () => { if (sel.includes(w)) sel = sel.filter(x => x !== w); else if (sel.length < 4) sel.push(w); msg = ""; draw(); };
      grid.appendChild(t);
    });
    wrap.appendChild(grid);
    wrap.appendChild(mk("p","msg",msg));
    wrap.appendChild(mk("p","hint","Mistakes: " + mistakes));
    const row = mk("div","row");
    const sh = mk("button","ghost","Shuffle"); sh.type = "button"; sh.onclick = () => { shuffle(order); draw(); };
    const de = mk("button","ghost","Deselect"); de.type = "button"; de.onclick = () => { sel = []; msg = ""; draw(); };
    const sb = mk("button","","Submit"); sb.type = "button"; sb.disabled = sel.length !== 4; sb.onclick = submit;
    row.append(sh, de, sb);
    wrap.appendChild(row);
  }
  draw();
}

const el = (t, c, x) => { const e = document.createElement(t); if (c) e.className = c; if (x) e.textContent = x; return e; };

/* ---- Clue 2: Redactle (edit the text/title) ---- */
const RED = {
  title: "Ben Stokes",
  free: "a an the and or of in on at to from for with by as is was were be been has have had he his him that this who which all one before after than also into over during while not no it its s three world played around born multiple international".split(" "),
  text: `Benjamin Andrew Stokes (born 4 June 1991) is an English former international cricketer who captained the England Test team from 2022 to 2026. Stokes played for England in all three formats and is regarded as one of England's greatest all-rounders. In domestic cricket, he represents Durham and has played in multiple Twenty20 leagues around the world. He was part of the England team that won the 2019 Cricket World Cup and the 2022 T20 World Cup.

Born in Christchurch, New Zealand, Stokes moved to England as a child. He made his ODI and T20I debuts in 2011 and his Test debut in 2013. He was part of the England team that won the 2019 Cricket World Cup, top-scoring in England's innings in the final before batting in the tied Super Over, winning the Man of the Match award. He was named the Wisden Leading Cricketer in the World in 2019, 2020 and 2022, and won the ICC Award for Best Men's Cricketer and BBC Sports Personality of the Year Award in 2019. He was appointed captain of England's Test team in April 2022. He was part of the England team that won the 2022 T20 World Cup, top-scoring in the final.

An all-rounder, Stokes is a left-handed middle-order batsman and right-arm fast bowler. He holds the Test world record for most runs in an innings at number six, scoring 258 against South Africa during England's 2015–16 tour. In the same Test, he and Jonny Bairstow set the world record for highest sixth-wicket stand in Tests, at 399. In February 2023, he set a new record for the total number of sixes hit in a Test career, surpassing the previous tally of 107 set by his coach at the time, Brendon McCullum, and reaching 138 sixes at retirement. He played his 100th test match against India on 15 February 2024. He retired from international cricket on 29 June 2026.`
};
function buildRedactle(box, onWin){
  const wrap = el("div"), parts = RED.text.split(/([A-Za-z0-9]+)/), tw = RED.title.toLowerCase().split(" ");
  const guessed = new Set(), log = []; let won = false, last = "";
  box.appendChild(wrap);
  function draw(){
    wrap.innerHTML = "";
    const rt = el("div","rt");
    rt.appendChild(el("p","ttl", RED.title.split(" ").map(w => won || guessed.has(w.toLowerCase()) ? w : "█".repeat(w.length)).join(" ")));
    RED.text.split("\n\n").forEach(par => {
      const p = el("p");
      par.split(/([A-Za-z0-9]+)/).forEach((t, k) => {
        if (k % 2 === 0) { if (t) p.appendChild(document.createTextNode(t)); return; }
        const l = t.toLowerCase(), show = won || RED.free.includes(l) || guessed.has(l);
        const s = el("span", show ? (l === last ? "n" : "") : "h", show ? t : "█".repeat(t.length));
        p.appendChild(s);
      });
      rt.appendChild(p);
    });
    wrap.appendChild(rt);
    if (won) { wrap.appendChild(el("p","msg","It's Ben Stokes! Your clue is on its way…")); return; }
    const f = el("form"), i = el("input"), b = el("button","","Guess");
    i.placeholder = "Type a word (or the name!)"; i.setAttribute("autocapitalize","off"); i.setAttribute("autocorrect","off"); i.spellcheck = false; i.setAttribute("aria-label","Guess"); b.type = "submit";
    f.append(i, b);
    f.onsubmit = e => { e.preventDefault(); guess(i.value); };
    wrap.appendChild(f);
    wrap.appendChild(el("p","glog", log.length ? "Guesses: " + log.map(g => g.w + " (" + g.n + ")").join(" · ") : "No guesses yet."));
    i.focus({preventScroll:true});
  }
  function guess(raw){
    const full = raw.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z ]/g, "").trim().replace(/\s+/g, " ");
    const named = ["ben stokes","benjamin stokes","benjamin andrew stokes","ben andrew stokes"].includes(full);
    raw.toLowerCase().split(/\s+/).forEach(w => {
      w = w.replace(/[^a-z0-9]/g, "");
      if (!w || guessed.has(w) || RED.free.includes(w)) return;
      guessed.add(w); last = w;
      log.unshift({w, n: parts.filter(t => t.toLowerCase() === w).length + (tw.includes(w) ? 1 : 0)});
    });
    if (named || tw.every(w => guessed.has(w))) { won = true; draw(); onWin(); return; }
    draw();
  }
  draw();
}

/* ---- Clue 3: Voices (replace names + add audio as data: URIs in src) ---- */
const VOICES = [
  {ok:["angelo mathews", "mathews", "angelo"], src:"data:audio/mp4;base64,"},
  {ok:["mushfiqur rahim", "mushfiqur", "mushfiq", "rahim", "mushfiqr rahim"], src:"data:audio/mp4;base64,"},
  {ok:["shai hope", "hope"], src:"data:audio/mp4;base64,"},
  {ok:["sikandar raza", "sikander raza", "raza", "sikandar", "sikander"], src:"data:audio/mp4;base64,"},
  {ok:["trent boult", "boult", "trent"], src:"data:audio/mp4;base64,"}
];
function buildVoices(box, onWin){
  const done = new Set(), rows = [], msg = el("p","msg");
  VOICES.forEach((v, i) => {
    const r = el("div","vrow"); r.appendChild(el("b","","Player " + (i+1)));
    if (v.src) { const a = el("audio"); a.controls = true; a.src = v.src; r.appendChild(a); }
    else r.appendChild(el("span","hint","🔇 Recording not added yet"));
    const inp = el("input"); inp.placeholder = "Whose voice?"; inp.setAttribute("autocapitalize","off"); inp.setAttribute("autocorrect","off"); inp.spellcheck = false; inp.setAttribute("aria-label","Player " + (i+1) + " name");
    r.appendChild(inp); box.appendChild(r); rows.push({r, inp, v});
  });
  const btn = el("button","","Check answers"); btn.type = "button";
  btn.onclick = () => {
    rows.forEach((x, i) => {
      if (done.has(i)) return;
      if (x.v.ok.includes(norm(x.inp.value))) { done.add(i); x.inp.disabled = true; x.r.classList.add("good"); x.r.appendChild(el("span","","correct")); }
    });
    msg.textContent = done.size + " of " + VOICES.length + " correct" + (done.size < VOICES.length ? " — keep listening!" : "");
    if (done.size === VOICES.length) onWin();
  };
  box.append(btn, msg);
}
const GAMES = {connections: buildGame, redactle: buildRedactle, voices: buildVoices};

});
$("ringsvg").innerHTML = rh;
const fitRings = () => RINGS.forEach((o, i) => {

  if (len) tx.style.fontSize = (o.s * L / len) + "px";
});
fitRings(); if (document.fonts) document.fonts.ready.then(fitRings);
const spins = RINGS.map((o,i) => $("g"+i).animate([{transform:"rotate(0deg)"},{transform:"rotate("+(360*o.dir)+"deg)"}], {duration:o.d*1000, iterations:Infinity}));
const rate = x => spins.forEach(a => a.updatePlaybackRate(x));
const heroQ = document.querySelector(".hero");
heroQ.addEventListener("pointermove", e => {
  if (e.pointerType === "touch") return;
  const r = $("wrap").getBoundingClientRect();
  rate(Math.hypot(e.clientX - (r.left + r.width/2), e.clientY - (r.top + r.height/2)) < r.width/2 ? 2.2 : 1);
});
heroQ.addEventListener("pointerleave", () => rate(1));

/* drag the floating pictures anywhere on the landing page */
const heroEl = document.querySelector(".hero"), centreEl = document.querySelector(".centre");
let grow = 1, eats = 0;
const STAGES = [centreEl.src, "data:image/webp;base64,", "data:image/webp;base64,"];
document.querySelectorAll(".fl").forEach(el => {
  let sx = 0, sy = 0, ox = 0, oy = 0, on = false;
  el.draggable = false;
  el.addEventListener("pointerdown", e => {
    const cs = getComputedStyle(el); ox = parseFloat(cs.left) || 0; oy = parseFloat(cs.top) || 0; sx = e.clientX; sy = e.clientY; on = true;
    el.style.left = ox + "px"; el.style.top = oy + "px";
    el.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId); el.classList.add("drag"); e.preventDefault();
  });
  el.addEventListener("pointermove", e => {
    if (!on) return;
    const nx = Math.min(Math.max(ox + e.clientX - sx, 10), heroEl.clientWidth - el.offsetWidth + 10);
    const ny = Math.min(Math.max(oy + e.clientY - sy, 10), heroEl.clientHeight - el.offsetHeight + 10);
    el.style.left = nx + "px"; el.style.top = ny + "px";
    const r = el.getBoundingClientRect(), c = centreEl.getBoundingClientRect(), mx = r.left + r.width/2, my = r.top + r.height/2;
    centreEl.classList.toggle("hot", mx > c.left - 8 && mx < c.right + 8 && my > c.top - 8 && my < c.bottom + 8);
  });
  el._home = {l: el.style.left, t: el.style.top};
  const end = e => {
    if (!on) return;
    on = false; el.classList.remove("drag"); centreEl.classList.remove("hot");
    if (e.type !== "pointerup") return;
    const r = el.getBoundingClientRect(), c = centreEl.getBoundingClientRect();
    const mx = r.left + r.width/2, my = r.top + r.height/2;
    if (mx > c.left - 8 && mx < c.right + 8 && my > c.top - 8 && my < c.bottom + 8) {
      grow = Math.min(grow + 0.04, 1.4);
      eats++; const st = eats >= 5 ? 2 : eats >= 2 ? 1 : 0; if (centreEl.src !== STAGES[st]) centreEl.src = STAGES[st];
      centreEl.style.setProperty("--g", grow);
      centreEl.classList.remove("chomp"); void centreEl.offsetWidth; centreEl.classList.add("chomp");
      el.style.left = el._home.l; el.style.top = el._home.t;
      el.classList.remove("pop"); void el.offsetWidth; el.classList.add("pop");
    }
  };
  el.addEventListener("pointerup", end);
  el.addEventListener("pointercancel", end);
  el.addEventListener("contextmenu", e => e.preventDefault());
});

/* keep the floating pictures outside the ring of text */
const floats = [...document.querySelectorAll(".fl")];
function layout(){
  const hw = heroEl.clientWidth, hh = heroEl.clientHeight;
  const hr = heroEl.getBoundingClientRect(), wr = $("wrap").getBoundingClientRect();
  const cx = wr.left - hr.left + wr.width/2, cy = wr.top - hr.top + wr.height/2, R = wr.width/2 + 8;
  const rel = n => { const r = n.getBoundingClientRect(); return {l: r.left - hr.left, t: r.top - hr.top, r: r.right - hr.left, b: r.bottom - hr.top}; };
  const placed = [".tip span", ".go"].map(s => document.querySelector(s)).filter(Boolean).map(rel);
  const hit = (a, b) => !(a.r + 6 < b.l || b.r + 6 < a.l || a.b + 6 < b.t || b.b + 6 < a.t);
  floats.forEach(el => {
    if (!el._f) el._f = {x: parseFloat(el.style.left)/100, y: parseFloat(el.style.top)/100};
    const w = el.offsetWidth, h = el.offsetHeight, half = Math.hypot(w, h)/2;
    const ok = (l, t) => l >= 4 && t >= 4 && l + w <= hw - 4 && t + h <= hh - 4 && !placed.some(p => hit({l, t, r: l + w, b: t + h}, p));
    let l = el._f.x*hw - 10, t = el._f.y*hh - 10;
    if (!(Math.hypot(l + w/2 - cx, t + h/2 - cy) >= R + half && ok(l, t))) {
      const a0 = Math.atan2(t + h/2 - cy, l + w/2 - cx); let best = null;
      for (let k = 0; k <= 36 && !best; k++) for (const s of (k ? [1, -1] : [1])) {
        const a = a0 + s*k*Math.PI/18, d = R + half + 4;
        const ll = cx + d*Math.cos(a) - w/2, tt = cy + d*Math.sin(a) - h/2;
        if (ok(ll, tt)) { best = {l: ll, t: tt}; break; }
      }
      if (best) { l = best.l; t = best.t; }
    }
    placed.push({l, t, r: l + w, b: t + h});
    el.style.left = (l + 10) + "px"; el.style.top = (t + 10) + "px";
    el._home = {l: el.style.left, t: el.style.top};
  });
}
Promise.all(floats.map(i => i.decode ? i.decode().catch(() => {}) : 0)).then(layout);
let lastW = innerWidth;
addEventListener("resize", () => { if (innerWidth !== lastW) { lastW = innerWidth; layout(); } });
$("intro").textContent = HUNT.intro;
document.title = HUNT.title.replace(/[^\w\s,!']/g, "").trim();

function confetti(){
  const fx = $("fx"), em = ["🎉","🎈","⭐","🪙","🎂","✨"];
  for (let i=0;i<40;i++){
    const s = document.createElement("span");
    s.textContent = em[i % em.length];
    s.style.left = Math.random()*100 + "vw";
    s.style.animationDuration = (2.5 + Math.random()*2.5) + "s";
    s.style.animationDelay = Math.random()*1 + "s";
    fx.appendChild(s);
    setTimeout(() => s.remove(), 6500);
  }
}

function render(){
  const list = $("list");
  list.innerHTML = "";
  levels.forEach((lv, i) => {
    const done = i < unlocked, current = i === unlocked;
    const card = document.createElement("section");
    card.className = "card " + (done ? "open" : current ? "" : "locked") + (lv.finale ? " finale" : "");
        card.innerHTML = `<div class="head"><div class="num">${lv.finale ? "★" : i+1}</div><h2></h2></div>`;
    card.querySelector("h2").textContent = lv.title;
    if (FACES[i]) { const im = new Image(); im.className = "face"; im.alt = ""; im.src = FACES[i]; card.prepend(im); }
    if (done) {
      const b = document.createElement("div");
      b.className = "body";
      const showClue = () => {
        const c = document.createElement("div");
        c.className = "clue" + (lv.poem ? " poem" : "");
        c.textContent = lv.text;
        b.appendChild(c);
      };
      if (lv.game && !solved[i]) {
        const p = document.createElement("p");
        p.className = "hint";
        p.textContent = lv.intro;
        b.appendChild(p);
        GAMES[lv.game](b, () => { solved[i] = 1; try { localStorage.setItem(KEY + "-game", JSON.stringify(solved)); } catch(e){} setTimeout(showClue, 700); });
      } else showClue();
      card.appendChild(b);
    } else if (current) {
      const b = document.createElement("div");
      b.className = "body";
      b.innerHTML = `<p class="hint"></p>
        <form autocomplete="off"><input type="text" placeholder="Enter the secret password" aria-label="Password" autocapitalize="off" autocorrect="off" spellcheck="false"><button type="submit">Unlock</button></form>
        <p class="msg" role="status"></p>`;
      b.querySelector(".hint").textContent = lv.hint || "";
      const form = b.querySelector("form"), input = b.querySelector("input"), msg = b.querySelector(".msg");
      form.addEventListener("submit", e => {
        e.preventDefault();
        if (norm(input.value) === norm(lv.password)) {
          unlocked = i + 1; save(); render();
          if (lv.finale) confetti();
          const el = $("list").children[i];
          if (el) el.scrollIntoView({behavior:"smooth", block:"center"});
        } else {
          msg.textContent = "Hmm, that's not it. Try again, matey! 🏴‍☠️";
          form.classList.remove("shake"); void form.offsetWidth; form.classList.add("shake");
        }
      });
      card.appendChild(b);
    } else {
      const p = document.createElement("p");
      p.className = "hint";
      p.style.margin = "10px 0 0";
      p.textContent = "Locked — solve the previous clue first.";
      card.appendChild(p);
    }
    list.appendChild(card);
  });
  $("fill").style.width = (unlocked / levels.length * 100) + "%";
  $("count").textContent = unlocked >= levels.length ? "All clues unlocked!" : `${unlocked} of ${levels.length} unlocked`;
}

$("reset").addEventListener("click", () => {
  if (confirm("Restart the hunt from Clue 1?")) { unlocked = 0; save(); solved = {}; try { localStorage.removeItem(KEY + "-game"); } catch(e){} render(); window.scrollTo({top:0,behavior:"smooth"}); }
});
render();
</script>
</body></html>
